instanceNavigationGuidance.instructions: Published guide approach: find the Krol'dok Stronghold portal north of Sunnyglade in Riverglades, east of the closed city approach. Horde: approach from Rog'mar if its flight point is known, otherwise from the Badlands. Alliance: travel north from Farholde Keep if its flight point is known, otherwise approach from Redridge. These are written regional directions; exact entrance coordinates, current access and in-instance floors remain unverified.
